name: Stanford University
character: The campus features one-storied Mission Revival and English-style buildings with dark red tiled roofs, a seasonal lake, and sculpture gardens.

landmarks.name: Main Quad
landmarks.quote: Contemporary campus landmarks include the Main Quad and Memorial Church,
landmarks.look: A large central quadrangle surrounded by one-storied, dark-red-tiled buildings.

landmarks.name: Hoover Tower
landmarks.quote: the Stanford Mausoleum with the nearby Angel of Grief, Hoover Tower,

landmarks.name: Green Library
landmarks.quote: The main library in the SU library system is the Green Library,
landmarks.look: A large main university library building with reading rooms.

landmarks.name: Cantor Center for Visual Arts
landmarks.quote: Stanford is home to the Cantor Center for Visual Arts, a museum
landmarks.look: A museum with galleries, terraces, a courtyard, and sculpture gardens.

landmarks.name: Lake Lagunita
landmarks.quote: The central campus includes a seasonal lake (Lake Lagunita, an irrigation reservoir),
landmarks.look: A seasonal lake and irrigation reservoir, sometimes dry or filled with water.

landmarks.name: Bing Concert Hall
landmarks.quote: the Cantor Center for Visual Arts and the Bing Concert Hall,
landmarks.look: A plain campus concert hall building.

landmarks.name: Rodin Sculpture Garden
landmarks.quote: Hoover Tower, the Rodin Sculpture Garden, the Papua New Guinea Sculpture Garden,

landmarks.name: Papua New Guinea Sculpture Garden
landmarks.quote: The Papua New Guinea Sculpture Garden near Roble Hall features wood carvings and "totem poles".
landmarks.look: An outdoor garden featuring wood carvings and totem poles.
